import sys, time
from pathlib import Path
import serial

port = Path('/tmp/c6-soak-port').read_text().strip()
duration = float(sys.argv[1])
label = sys.argv[2]
ser = None
for _ in range(40):
    try:
        ser = serial.Serial(port, 115200, timeout=0.25, write_timeout=1)
        break
    except Exception as exc:
        last = exc
        time.sleep(0.25)
if ser is None:
    raise SystemExit(f'failed to open {port}: {last}')
start = time.monotonic()
last_status = -300.0
last_heartbeat = -300.0
with open('/tmp/c6-soak.log', 'ab', buffering=0) as out:
    marker = f'\n=== SOAK {label} START {time.time():.3f} ===\n'.encode()
    out.write(marker)
    while True:
        elapsed = time.monotonic() - start
        if elapsed >= duration:
            break
        data = ser.read(4096)
        if data:
            out.write(data)
        if elapsed - last_status >= 300.0:
            ser.write(b'link status\n')
            ser.flush()
            last_status = elapsed
        if elapsed - last_heartbeat >= 300.0:
            print(f'SOAK_HEARTBEAT label={label} elapsed={int(elapsed)}s', flush=True)
            last_heartbeat = elapsed
    ser.write(b'link status\n')
    ser.flush()
    until = time.monotonic() + 1.0
    while time.monotonic() < until:
        data = ser.read(4096)
        if data:
            out.write(data)
    out.write(f'\n=== SOAK {label} END {time.time():.3f} ===\n'.encode())
ser.close()
